=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5537-5584 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The standalone stall-recovery conflict redirect skips bookkeeping that should accompany the dispatched conflict resolver.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed that the `continue` path bypasses at least `add_healing_note` and `cancel_zombie_runs_for_issue`; one reviewer also noted `STALL_HEALING_CHANGED=true` is skipped, while another described the cancellation omission as lower severity.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6250-6290 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` only treats success and already-dispatched as special cases, so dispatch failures just warn and continue.
  WHY: A nonzero, non-2 return can leave conflict dispatch attempts silently deferred for a poll cycle, which the reviewer judged to be a runtime robustness issue.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1148-1157 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The render-recovery gate can evaluate preflight classification before the failure kind is determined.
  WHY: Both reviewers pointed to the gate using `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS`/defaulting behavior before classification, which could incorrectly skip render recovery on lint failures; one reviewer disagreed and said the logic is actually correct.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1191-1739 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: Some preflight failure paths set `PRE_FLIGHT_STATUS="fail"` without also setting `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS`.
  WHY: If those paths omit the class, the render-recovery gate defaults to non-lint and suppresses rerender recovery for valid template-mode failures.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:297-420 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The render-recovery test does not exercise the `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` gating logic.
  WHY: The reviewers agreed this leaves a coverage gap where regressions in the lint/non-lint gate could slip through even though the behavioral rerender path is tested.
- README.md, agents.md | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The documentation does not mention the REST fallback cost for `_check_open_pr_conflict_guard`.
  WHY: Both reviewers said the docs should note that a cache miss triggers a `GET /pulls/{n}` fallback, though this was treated as a low-severity documentation gap rather than a runtime bug.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5537-5570 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Standalone stall-recovery conflict redirect misses `add_healing_note` and `cancel_zombie_runs_for_issue`.
  WHY: When `_check_open_pr_conflict_guard` returns true, the code dispatches conflict resolver and `continue`s, skipping `add_healing_note` and `cancel_zombie_runs_for_issue`; the reviewer said this breaks healing summaries and zombie-run cleanup.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6250-6290 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` error handling only treats success and already-dispatched as special cases.
  WHY: Return code 1 just warns and continues, so transient dispatch failures can silently defer conflict handling for one poll cycle.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1148 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` check happens before `classify_preflight_failure`.
  WHY: The reviewer said the gate can see `"none"` or an unset value before classification, causing recovery to be skipped even when classification would identify a lint failure.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Test doesn't exercise `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` gating logic.
  WHY: The mocked flow does not cover `"none"`, `"non_lint"`, or unset states, so regressions in the gate would not be caught.
- README.md, agents.md | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Documentation doesn't mention REST fallback API cost for `_check_open_pr_conflict_guard`.
  WHY: The reviewer said operators expect zero extra API calls on cache hit, but a cache miss triggers a REST `GET /pulls/{n}` fallback.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5208 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_check_open_pr_conflict_guard` exports an empty head ref to the dispatcher.
  WHY: The reviewer claimed the helper assigns the head ref to a local `head_ref` variable but fails to export `STALL_CONFLICT_HEAD_REF`, so the conflict resolver dispatch would run without a target branch.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5546-5573 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The conflict-dispatch redirect path skips essential stall-recovery bookkeeping.
  WHY: The reviewer said `continue` bypasses `add_healing_note`, `cancel_zombie_runs_for_issue`, and `STALL_HEALING_CHANGED=true`, which would leave tracking and cleanup incomplete.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1150-1153 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The render-recovery gate checks `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` before `classify_preflight_failure` has executed.
  WHY: The reviewer said this can skip deterministic rerender recovery if the class is missing or incorrect before deep classification runs.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1191-1739 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Several preflight failure paths set `PRE_FLIGHT_STATUS="fail"` without setting `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS`.
  WHY: The reviewer said this defaults the gate to non-lint and suppresses template rerender recovery for valid Python syntax or canary-tool failures.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:324-417 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The render-recovery test does not initialize or check `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS`.
  WHY: The reviewer said the test bypasses the real classification logic, so a regression in the lint gate would not be caught.
- README.md / agents.md | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The documentation omits the REST fallback cost.
  WHY: The reviewer said a cache miss triggers one REST API call and that should be documented to avoid operator surprise.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `_check_open_pr_conflict_guard` repeatedly parses the same JSON string with `jq`.
  WHY: The reviewer suggested combining the parsed fields into one `jq` call to reduce subprocess overhead.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/ochestrate_oll_Process. sh:Lines 55/37-55/65 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The standalone stall recovery conflict redirect does not call `add_healing_note` or set `STALL_HEALING_CHANGED=true`.
  WHY: The reviewer said the `continue` path skips healing tracking, so the conflict-resolver dispatch is omitted from the operator-visible healing summary.
- scripts/validate_Process. sh:Line 11/147 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The render recovery gate relies on `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` before all paths set it.
  WHY: The reviewer said a failure path that does not set the variable would default to `"non_lint"` and incorrectly skip render recovery.
